why: Preprint 'Towards Trans-Exponential O-minimal Expansion of (R,+,·,0,1<)' by Yayi Fu (arXiv 2604.03477, submitted April 2026) directly addresses this exact open question, adding a trans-exponential function to R_an,exp and reducing its o-minimality to a conjectural regularity condition; not a full resolution but a specific, on-target advance.

found.title: Towards Trans-Exponential O-minimal Expansion of $(\mathbb{R},+,\cdot, 0, 1 <)$
found.note: Preprint by Yayi Fu constructing a candidate trans-exponential o-minimal expansion, with o-minimality conditional on a regular-values conjecture; not read in full.
